title: First Tool Check
briefing: Place the starter grid kit, then Deep Scan the Small Battery Bank so MissionCore can verify the first PowerGrid loop.
fieldGuide: The starter loop is deliberately small: hand crank generator, low voltage cable, and one small battery bank. Scan the battery after it is placed, then confirm the HoloMap next-objective marker if HoloMap is present.

objectives.label: Deep Scan the Small Battery Bank
objectives.detail: Place the starter battery, connect the first loop, then scan the battery block.

objectives.label: Check the power spine marker
objectives.detail: Use the Pack #2 HoloMap layer when available; otherwise continue from the Terminal mission route.

rewards.label: Scrap Wire
rewards.detail: A small repair bundle for the next starter route.

rewards.label: Fuse
rewards.detail: A single safety component for the next diagnostic step.

metadata.completionFeedback: Starter power loop verified. Processor Worksite is ready to mark.
